name: Everburn Blade

Extra Radiant damage

location: A ruined mountain monastery — reward for solving its dawn puzzle

Melee attackers who hit you can be left Reeling

Punishes melee attackers who miss
location: Forged yourself at an ancient adamantine forge in the depths

name: Helldusk Armour

properties: +3 heavy armour
Cast Fly
Fire resistance
Bonus to saving throws

Grants a giant-sized form for heavy extra damage

name: Nyrulna
roleDescription: A legendary trident that explodes with thunder when thrown and returns to your hand — superb for throwing builds.

Returns when thrown
Throws explode with thunder
Grants great mobility

Resistance to fire and cold
